decisions.text: Notes are refused once answered: after the answer, new information is a follow-up question (--spawned), not a note. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

'The inbox' in the intention is `cairn question list` (render()); cairn/tools/operator_inbox is its own component (RULE 1) and is out of this ticket — it keeps listing the question line; show prints the whole record, notes included. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

question.py: def note(qid, text, *, by, root=None) -> dict beside answer(): lacks are text empty after strip, by empty after strip, and (after read(), which already refuses an absent id) record['resolved'] true; every lack named in one Refused and nothing written. Otherwise record.setdefault('notes', []).append({'text': text.strip(), 'by': by.strip(), 'at': _now()}) and _write(_path(record['id'], root), record, verb='cast', why=f"note on {id} by {by}"); returns the record. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
render(): for each entry of q.get('notes') or [], one line indented like born_of: 'note {at} ({by}): {text}', printed after born_of and before the answered line. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

__main__.py: sub.add_parser('note') with positional qid and text and --by required; calls Q.note(args.qid, args.text, by=args.by) and prints 'noted: {id} ({n} note(s))'; a Refused exits 2 through the existing handler; a missing --by exits 2 from argparse. The module docstring gains the note line. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The proof is cairn/tools/question/proofs/test_a_question_takes_a_note.py, PROVES {'db99e97f7b4f': {'1','2'}}, written red-first 2026-10-11 (subject absent); tooth 1: two notes append two {text,by,at} entries in order, render() shows both, the CLI note verb lands and show prints it; tooth 2: empty text, empty by, an answered question, and the CLI without --by each refuse with the record's bytes unchanged. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
D3's why string is f"note on {record['id']} by {by.strip()}" — the id comes from the record read() returned, never an undefined name. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
